body: The bucket has a closure notice taped inside the rim. The bowl holds a list of names, half of them struck out.
title: bucket and bowl

body: Two water bottles are tied together with twine. Each has a numbered tag and a strip of tape. A patrol must have left them as a marker.
title: Water bottle and twine

body: A tarp covers a kettle and a bucket stacked together. Tape says do not move, closed by order until cleared. A checkpoint number is written on the kettle.
title: Kettle, bucket and tarp

body: The untouched bowl has the same green ring as the sprayer can. The overturned water bottle near it is clear. A wilted seedling lies across the bucket rim.
title: Bowl, bucket and water bottle

body: My fishing net caught pale spray granules where the runoff narrowed. The bucket of dry mud from above the waterline has none. Dead fish lay where the crop rows end.
title: Fishing net and bucket

body: The empty jar and the jar lid both carry a guard's numbered tape. A list taped to the shelf shows 12 names, all crossed off. An order says nobody opens or mentions them.
title: Empty jar and jar lid

body: The rubber hose still smells like well water. A wrench lies near it, handle stained greenish. The fertilizer bag is torn open and empty.
title: Rubber hose, wrench and fertilizer

body: A spoon hangs from the bucket by a tagged string. The tag lists a count of people and a closure date. The count is written over twice.
title: Bucket and spoon

body: The boot has spray residue caked in its tread. A bucket of gray rinse water is beside it. The seedlings in it have yellowed, and the other boot is clean.
title: Work boots and bucket

body: The wrench has a numbered tag wired to the handle. A bucket beyond it holds a sheet of orders to stay silent.
title: Wrench and bucket
